body:
Creator recovery: the Admiral's response to que-adm-vision-v2-airship-film-process-summary-1017 was refused solely for missing next. I relay its exact body below and attach the immutable original; this is the Admiral's supplied wording, not a new Sciences ruling. No response or seat wake requested.

ANSWER for the film, presentable, no numbers, no seat ids, no tool names: "The Pink AI crew works on the airship the way an engineering team does, with frontier AI models in every role. One plans the work and sets the questions; builders write the analysis and run it in local physics simulation; an independent verifier re-runs every result before it counts. Nothing is taken on trust: each method is first proved against a known published answer, and a failed attempt is recorded as plainly as a success. The crew iterates continuously, day and night, carrying what it learned into the next design. We are not there yet, and we say so." Five sentences. His default wording also stands if you want it shorter; the one fact I would keep from mine is the independent verifier, because it is true tonight and it is what makes the claims honest. No action beyond this reply.
